Metadata.title: Fogata — stories around the fire
Metadata.description: A warm home for long-form stories. Read, write and share around the campfire.

headlines: Pull up a seat. Someone is telling a story.
Every great story starts with a spark.
Stay a while. The fire is still warm.
There's always room for one more by the fire.
Some stories take time. Take yours.
Bring a story. Stay for a few more.
The night is young and the fire is lit.
Gather round. This one is worth hearing.
Home.lede: Fogata is a warm home for long-form writing. No ads, no feeds built to keep you scrolling, just stories and the people who tell them.
Home.empty: No stories yet. The fire has just been lit, and yours could be the first.

Design.title: Style guide
Design.lede: The living reference for Fogata's tokens and components. Switch themes in the header to check every pairing.
Design.readingSample: Reading comes first. Typography, speed and calm beat feature count. The line you are reading is set at the same size, leading and measure as a story body, so it should sit comfortably between 65 and 75 characters.
Design.flameCaption: The flame flickers gently and holds still when reduced motion is on.
Design.vocabularyNote: Spanish UI uses the Spanish terms; English UI uses the English terms. First use always explains the plain meaning.
Design.imageSearchNote: Writers pick cover and inline photos from Unsplash. Picking a photo tells Unsplash it was used and credits the photographer under the image.
